IOLCP.NS.title: IOL Chemicals — Q2 FY27 Quarterly Results & Investor Presentation
bullets: Revenue grew 18.4% YoY to ₹892 Cr; EBITDA margin expanded 320 bps to 21.2%
Ibuprofen API capacity expanded to 10,000 TPA — largest single-site facility globally
Board approved ₹250 Cr capex for backward integration into acetic anhydride
Export revenue now 38% of total, up from 29% in prior year quarter
Management guided for 22-24% EBITDA margin range for FY27E

TCS.NS.title: TCS — Q2 FY27 Earnings Release & Analyst Call Transcript
bullets: Revenue of $7.84B, up 7.2% YoY in constant currency; sequential growth of 1.8%
Total Contract Value (TCV) at record $12.2B; book-to-bill ratio of 1.56x
GenAI practice signed 85 engagements worth $900M cumulative in 9 months
Operating margin at 26.2%; free cash flow conversion at 108% of net income
Attrition at 13.2% — management expects stabilization at 12% by Q4

HDFCBANK.NS.title: HDFC Bank — Q2 FY27 Results & Post-Merger Integration Update
bullets: Net interest income grew 24.3% YoY to ₹31,420 Cr; NIM at 3.65%, up 12 bps QoQ
Branch consolidation 78% complete — on track for full integration by Q1 FY28
CASA ratio recovering: 39.2% vs 37.8% in prior quarter; added 2.8M savings accounts
Gross NPA at 1.34% (blended); legacy HDFC Ltd mortgage book at 2.1% — cleanup provisioned
Board approved ₹12,000 Cr Tier-2 bond issuance to optimize capital structure

PENNY.NS.title: Penny Micro Industries — Annual Report FY26 Filing
bullets: Revenue declined 12% YoY to ₹48 Cr; net loss of ₹8.2 Cr vs profit of ₹1.1 Cr prior year
Auditor flagged going concern qualification due to negative operating cash flow for 3 consecutive years
Promoter holding increased from 62% to 68% via preferential allotment — dilutive to minorities
Single manufacturing facility with no disaster recovery or alternative site
Related party transactions with promoter-linked entities increased 45% YoY

HIGHPRICE.NS.title: MRF Ltd — Q2 FY27 Results & Investor Presentation
bullets: Revenue grew 11.8% YoY to ₹6,280 Cr driven by volume growth and premium mix improvement
EBITDA margin at 18.5% — benefiting from benign natural rubber prices and operational leverage
Launched 12 new SKUs in the SUV and EV tyre segment; EV-specific revenue doubled YoY
Capex of ₹1,200 Cr planned for new radial tyre plant in Gujarat — commissioning by FY28
Declared interim dividend of ₹3 per share; maintained consistent dividend track record

LOWCONF.NS.title: Suzlon Energy — Q2 FY27 Business Update & Order Pipeline
bullets: Revenue of ₹2,180 Cr, up 32% YoY; however, execution delays pushed ₹480 Cr to next quarter
Order book at ₹18,400 Cr — highest ever, but conversion to revenue remains key risk
Debt restructuring complete: net debt reduced to ₹1,200 Cr from ₹4,800 Cr in FY24
Government policy on wind energy RPO targets still pending finalization — creates uncertainty
Announced partnership with European turbine maker for 4.x MW platform; commercial production FY28
